article.headline: A Note on Brand Confusion: Weddings.io and \"Weddings.io Inc.\"
article.description: Weddings.io has owned this domain since 2015. A separate Ontario company, \"Weddings.io Inc.\" (operating aiweddings.io), is unrelated to us. Here's what we've done about the naming overlap.
